validity.researcher_notes: Same underlying project family as P2614: FERC Docket Nos. CP18-37-000 / CP18-38-000, the Sierrita Compressor Expansion Project in Pima County, AZ -- this row's SegmentName ('Sierrita Pima Expansion Project') names the docket's own county directly, and its Capacity (320.00 MMcf/d) is a close match to the ~322,794 Dth/d (~323 MMcf/d) of firm transportation service FERC certificated the project to add on Line No. 2177. FERC's Federal Register EA-availability notice (govinfo.gov FR-2018-06-20, primary/gov source) gives the full facility list: one new 15,900 HP compressor station, ~1,000 feet of suction/discharge piping and station-yard auxiliary facilities, a new 10-inch ultrasonic meter, and relocation of an existing mainline valve -- no new mainline pipe or lateral. AZPM (azpm.org, independent local news, 2019) corroborates: 'only a compressor station is being constructed, not new pipe.' The row's own LengthKnownKm (0.00) and RouteAccuracy ('no route') are already consistent with a compression-only project. Per the compression-only-expansion rule (LengthKnown=0 / Diameter=blank when no new physical pipe is laid), the blank Diameter is correct and this is a confirmation, not a fill. The wiki's '36 inches' describes the existing 61-mile Sierrita mainline (Line No. 2177), not this compressor-only project. Same possible-duplicate note as P2614 applies (P2614 and P2615 may represent one physical CP18-37/CP18-38 project split into two GEM rows) -- flagged for a human, not resolved here as it is outside this brief's Diameter/Operator scope.
